dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures with high-contrast, jagged light-grey perimeters against a dark-toned background. The most prominent is a large, closed loop on the posterior flank; a secondary, fragmented 'C' shape is positioned centrally on the lateral midline.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low-to-moderate density of small, isolated high-intensity light-grey pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily situated along the upper dorsal ridge and within the perimeters of the larger annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the large posterior annulus, the central fragmented annulus, and a distinct anterior light patch form a longitudinal chain with a wide obtuse angle at the central node.

other_distinctive_markers: A complex reticulated network of fine, interconnected light-grey lines is present across the central and posterior lateral surfaces, creating a distinct web-like visual texture.
